text: And stay there for a bit. Later on, when you’re feeling good, you can get curious with yourself and wonder what it was about what the other person did or said that actually felt like a violation. Maybe they did do something violating. Maybe they triggered something in you. But you don’t have to figure it out now in order to get out of the pit of your stomach and get into a happier place. You can always come back and decide later if this other person is actually evil or not.
